_comment: DATA LAYER — single source of truth for BernalierPups pSEO. Edit values here; every generated page reads from this. NEVER hardcode facts into page templates. Breed facts pulled directly from the live /bernalier-mini-bernese-mountain-dog/ breed guide and /bernalier-pricing/ + /health-guarantee/ pages on 2026-09-24.

primary.label: Bernalier
primary.cross: Bernese Mountain Dog x Cavalier King Charles Spaniel

breed.RED_LINE: NEVER mention Poodle, Doodle, or Bernedoodle. This breed is NOT crossed with Poodle — it is Bernese Mountain Dog x Cavalier King Charles Spaniel.

coat.shedding: moderate year-round, heavier in spring and fall

temperament: good with other dogs and cats

health.note: The cross draws from two well-established breeds; routine vet visits, a healthy diet, and proper grooming are recommended preventive care.

pricing._note: DYNAMIC — pull live from the evergreen /bernalier-pricing/ page (see engine/pricing.py). This page states BASE ranges by color, not per-litter prices like MGR, and does not rotate monthly the way the 'for sale' pages do.
pricing.deposit_terms: Refundable up to 2 years from deposit date IF the puppy has not yet been reserved (9% processing fee on refund). Once a specific puppy is reserved, the $300 is non-refundable/non-transferable and applies to the balance on Adoption Day.
pricing.healthcare_fee_note: Pre-adoption healthcare/homecare fee (vaccines, preventative care, vet/medical care before pickup). Added to base price. Not taxed.
pricing.sales_tax_note: 6% sales tax applies ONLY to puppies picked up or delivered in South Carolina. Puppies shipped to other states do not include sales tax.

automatic_tier.coverage: congenital/genetic issues, up to 100% of puppy purchase price — AUTOMATIC, included with every puppy

conditional_on: owner purchases and maintains Pet Insurance for at least the first 6 months of ownership
owner uses one of the recommended pet foods (purchased only through provided links)
extended_tier.coverage: deductibles and copay costs, up to the price of the puppy
extended_tier.void_if: Pet Insurance not maintained for the first 6 months (partial credit toward another puppy possible if the recommended-food condition is still met)

health_guarantee.generator_instruction: ALWAYS describe the 12-year tier as CONDITIONAL, never as automatically included. The 1-year tier IS automatic and can be stated as included.

process.detail: Fill out an application at /apply/ to show interest and check family fit
$300 refundable deposit (before a specific puppy is reserved)
Get matched, then pick up or use delivery — see /delivery-pickup/

existing_owner_pages._note: VERIFIED real URLs pulled via WP REST API from the live site on 2026-09-24. Link only to these. size and lifespan have NO dedicated pillar page yet (unlike MGR) — left null on purpose; the engine falls back to the breed guide (core) for those until dedicated pillars are built.

cannibalization_warning._note: Full inventory of the site's 49 pages + 7 posts pulled 2026-09-24 via WP REST API. Every 'for sale'/'for adoption' page found is NATIONAL — no state or city targeting at all. The engine's entire opportunity is the location-based long-tail, currently 100% untapped (unlike MGR, which already has 179 location pages live).
cannibalization_warning.for_sale_general: 17 existing litter/for-sale/adoption pages already cover generic national 'for sale'/'for adoption' intent, published roughly monthly by Andrew and never deleted — avoid generating generic for-sale pages of any kind.
cannibalization_warning.comparisons: bernese-mountain-dog-vs-bernalier, cavalier-vs-bernalier, bernese-mountain-dog-vs-cavalier, cavalier-king-charles-spaniel already exist — do not regenerate.
cannibalization_warning.homepage_owns: The HOMEPAGE ('home' slug, root /) ranks for the head term 'Mini Bernese Mountain Dog Puppies for Sale' — never generate pages targeting that head term + for-sale intent nationally.
